## Final merged data
```{r}
final_results <- sample_100 %>%
  select(trip_id, duration_micro_min, StartTime,
         start_stop_id_snap, start_stop_lat_snap, start_stop_lon_snap,
         end_stop_id_snap,   end_stop_lat_snap,   end_stop_lon_snap) %>%
  left_join(bike_summary,    by = "trip_id") %>%
  left_join(transit_summary, by = "trip_id")
```

## Summary stats
### Basic summary
```{r}
summary_stats <- final_results %>%
  summarise(
    avg_micromobility = mean(duration_micro_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_bike          = mean(bike_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_transit       = mean(transit_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),

    median_micromobility = median(duration_micro_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bike          = median(bike_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_transit       = median(transit_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

summary_stats
```

### Compute differences between modes
```{r}
diffs <- final_results %>%
  mutate(
    micro_vs_bike   = duration_micro_min - bike_duration_min,
    micro_vs_transit = duration_micro_min - transit_duration_min,
    bike_vs_transit  = bike_duration_min - transit_duration_min
  )
```

### Proportion of trips where each mode is fastest
```{r}
fastest_counts <- final_results %>%
  mutate(
    fastest = pmin(duration_micro_min, bike_duration_min, transit_duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    winner = case_when(
      fastest == duration_micro_min   ~ "Micromobility",
      fastest == bike_duration_min     ~ "Bike",
      fastest == transit_duration_min  ~ "Transit",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  count(winner)

fastest_counts
```

## Visualizations
```{r}
viz_data <- final_results %>%
  select(trip_id, duration_micro_min, bike_duration_min, transit_duration_min) %>%
  pivot_longer(-trip_id, names_to = "mode", values_to = "duration")

ggplot(viz_data, aes(x = mode, y = duration, fill = mode)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Comparing Travel Times by Mode",
       x = "", y = "Duration (minutes)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(final_results, aes(x = duration_micro_min, y = bike_duration_min)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Micromobility vs Bike Travel Times",
       x = "Micromobility (min)", y = "Bike (min)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(final_results, aes(x = duration_micro_min, y = transit_duration_min)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Micromobility vs Transit Travel Times",
       x = "Micromobility (min)", y = "Transit (min)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(viz_data, aes(x = duration, color = mode, fill = mode)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Travel Times",
       x = "Duration (minutes)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = sample_100,
    lng = ~start_stop_lon_snap,
    lat = ~start_stop_lat_snap,
    color = "blue", radius = 4,
    popup = ~paste("Trip", trip_id, "<br>Start Stop:", start_stop_id_snap)
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = sample_100,
    lng = ~end_stop_lon_snap,
    lat = ~end_stop_lat_snap,
    color = "red", radius = 4,
    popup = ~paste("Trip", trip_id, "<br>End Stop:", end_stop_id_snap)
  )
```

## Final comparison table
```{r}
final_table <- final_results %>%
  select(trip_id,
         micromobility_min = duration_micro_min,
         bike_min = bike_duration_min,
         transit_min = transit_duration_min)

head(final_table)
```

# save all data
```{r}
saveRDS(final_results, "final_googleapi_data_stats.rds")
saveRDS(summary_stats,   "summary_stats.rds")
saveRDS(diffs,           "mode_differences.rds")
saveRDS(fastest_counts,  "fastest_mode_counts.rds")
saveRDS(final_table,     "final_comparison_table.rds")
```
